detailed_descriptions.en: Step into the role of a night guard at a mansion, where the pay is almost too good to be true for just five nights of work. "Just watch over the maids in the mansion" you're told. How hard could that be? As it turns out, it's far more difficult than you'd expect. The question is, do you have what it takes? Control the lights from the security room to reveal what dwells in the darkness. Operate shutter doors to keep out unwanted guests, and monitor camera systems to keep an eye on those pesky maids as they skulk around the mansion. Every action consumes power, and you barely have enough to last the night. Manage your resources carefully, and your choices might get you through the night. With your power reserves ticking away towards zero with every move, one mistake could leave you without a monitor… or worse, without shutters. Survive all five nights if you want to live long enough to spend that hard earned cash. Bonus Stage Test your skills against the far more punishing Night 6. A special reward awaits those who have what it takes to endure. Monochrome Horror Experience an unsettling world stripped of color where black and white is all that remain to keep you company through the long nights.
